trust_decision.summary: The libxml parse options decide whether entities/DTD declarations inside an uploaded import XML are substituted (LIBXML_NOENT) when DOMDocument::loadXML parses it; the decision lives in a class-level options constant in the XML importer.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'XXE via Import'; the admin tools/import controller hands file contents straight to Xml::import, whose loadXML uses the options at system/import/xml.php:39-46.

fix_sites.entry_point: admin ?module=tools/import&action=upload (file upload or post file[] from CLI: cli.php:58) -> admin/controller/tools/import.php:57-94 -> Xml::import
fix_sites.module_kind: system library (importer), reached from admin controller and CLI

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Published fix touches only system/import/xml.php:39-46 (commit 8b9db6a is an unrelated page-taxonomy feature commit, fix.diff:1-487).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: system/import/rss.php only parses vendor marketplace/news feeds fetched from hardcoded https URLs (system/extensions/plugins.php:33-35, system/extensions/themes.php:40-42, admin/component/news.php:32-34), so a solver can argue the input is trusted and not the 'Import' feature named in the report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Import must still accept the project's own export format: CDATA-wrapped string columns (exported via createCDataSection) and LIBXML_NOCDATA/PARSEHUGE for large dumps; an over-broad fix (rejecting any DOCTYPE badly, dropping NOCDATA, or stripping CDATA/encoded '&' content) breaks round-trip export->import of content with HTML entities.

O6_input_shapes: server-side path(s) via post file / file[] array at admin/controller/tools/import.php:68-78

O7_producer.where: system/functions.php:1784 (getUrl caches fetched feed under ('url', md5(url)) and admin/component/news.php:62-64 caches parsed news) feeding system/import/rss.php:49

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Rss importer: identical options with LIBXML_NOENT, loadXML of remote feed content; reached from plugin/theme market listing and admin news component
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Feed comes from vendor-controlled hardcoded https URLs, not user upload; news domain only changeable via Event hook (admin/component/news.php:58)
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package (system/import), different file and class; callers in system/extensions/extensions.php:259 and admin/component/news.php:47

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a theme/plugin-zip info/manifest XML parsed with the Rss-style options during extension install (zip already extracted at system/extensions/extensions.php:228)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Extensions are uploaded zips and the code already reuses the import option set; a maintainer could add an XML manifest reader copying those flags.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: non-HTML template branch adding entity substitution for XML/JSON templates (array2xml output) with NOENT for 'entity rendering'
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: That branch already parses XML templates and theme files are user-uploadable; adding NOENT to make named entities render is a plausible convenience change; a HOW-type data producer (array2xml) the check never calls.
